text:
$HBAR went crazy, swinging about three times its normal daily range. It bounced up 23.6% and covered roughly 31% of price movement in the last 24 hours, far beyond the typical 10.7% spread.

$LINK wasn't far behind, its range was about twice what you'd expect. The token rose 5.7% and traded through a 15.5% band versus the usual 7.7%.

$ZEC also broke the norm, moving through a 16.8% window compared to its 9.8% average, while slipping 11.8% overall.

$BTC fell to $82,855.35, down 2.16% in 24 h, after hitting a high of $85,159.03 and testing a low near $82,613.13. Volume sat around 15,618 BTC, pushing quote volume past $1.31 B.

$ETH slid to $2,649.83, a 2.28% drop, after peaking at $2,719.51 and bottoming at $2,635.69. Trades piled up to roughly 220,917 ETH, with about $590.5 M changing hands.

$BNB slipped to $761.72, off 2.13%, after reaching $784.55 and briefly touching $758.51. Around 93,647 BNB moved, generating $72.4 M in quote volume.

All three tokens lost a couple of percent and stayed under their daily highs. Keep an eye on whether they hug the lows or bounce back toward the recent peaks.
